text: In medieval Italy, the Satanist Prince Prospero [orders a plague village burned|wrong|the powerful abuse their power] and shuts his nobles inside his castle to feast and torment their captives while the Red Death spreads outside. Inside, his consort Juliana [pledges her soul in the Black Room|wrong|bargains with dark powers], and a costumed guest burns from a chandelier. At the masked ball, where no one may wear red, a hooded figure in scarlet arrives, and [the dead keep dancing|rules|nothing can stop it].
